cases.title: An interpreter uses real serial speaking time

originalScenario.premise: Three participants and an interpreter complete a declared ten-minute exchange concurrently.

originalScenarioAndDisposition.disposition: KEEP expected boundary as adopted source direction
originalScenarioAndDisposition.finalExpected: The exchange advances10 actual minutes only if the full actual serial interpretation and contributions fit those10 minutes. Otherwise add the actual necessary interval. Concurrent participants do not multiply the clock, and an interpreter cannot supply another caster's components.

cases.timeModel: Each independent synthetic scenario has its own one shared clock; alternatives fork, not combine.
cases.readerExplanation: Ten paired thirty-second contributions and translations fit exactly into ten minutes. Four participants do not turn that into forty elapsed minutes. Another minute of original speech plus its translation adds two real minutes, and the interpreter cannot supply another caster’s verbal component.
